messages:
anna: Quick ask — HealthStack (healthtech startup) is asking for a POC credit. 3mo trial, heavy embed+inference usage, wants 40% off list for the POC and option to convert to 12mo reserved after. Need deal-desk + finance approval before I commit.
kevin: timeline?
anna: POC kickoff May 6 -> Aug 5. Decision point at end.
priya: tech note — they want Private VPC + HSM for embeddings. That adds infra ops overhead and lead time. Also they expect ~200M inference tokens/mo.
marcus: can you paste current list math and ARR equivalence? finance needs that to price concession.
anna: base list monthly = ~$120k (tokens + infra). 3mo list = $360k. 40% credit = $144k credit, they'd pay $216k for the POC. They also want onboarding (SSO, keys, runbook) included.
priya: quick cost calc: 200M tokens * $0.0004/token ≈ $80k/mo inference. Embeddings ≈ $30k/mo. Private infra + ops ~ $10k/mo. Numbers match list ballpark.
marcus: ok — what's the exact ask? 40% off + onboarding waiver + dedicated SE hours?
anna: yes to all. + 1 week dedicated SE during integration.
lucy: legal: need DPA + addendum for on-prem details and data residency. SOW must explicitly enumerate credits, termination triggers, and conversion mechanics.
marcus: deal desk preferred counter: 25% POC credit + $10k onboarding credit + 6 weeks of SE support. Anything >25% needs head_of_revenue sign-off.
kevin: can we add conversion clause that applies unused POC credit toward committed capacity if they convert within 30 days of POC end? client likes that.
marcus: yes — we can apply remaining credit to first invoice after conversion. SOW language required.
anna: client prefers refundable credit-to-convert model. Good negotiation lever.
marcus: action for me: send formal pricing exception by EOD Friday with (1) final POC scope, (2) SOW draft with conversion clause, (3) monthly token profile. I will route for approvals.
anna: will post SOW draft today.
dealbot: Approval workflow triggered: /deal-approval 3187654321 — Stage: Pricing Exception — Approvers: marcus, head_of_revenue — ETA 48h
marcus: routing to finance + revops. tagging @head_of_revenue for quick review :thumbsup:
kevin: pushing to expedite — they're evaluating 2 competitors and need a decision this week.
lucy: I'll prepare a DPA addendum template and mark sections for negotiation.
priya: SE support estimate: 40hrs during ramp + 16hrs post-conversion. I'll add note on private infra lead time (2-3 weeks) and risk to go-live.
anna: thanks — posting SOW link in a minute.
anna: SOW: https://drive.redwood/sales/healthstack/POC_SOW_v2.docx
marcus: got it. If they insist on 40% escalate to CEO for exceptions. Otherwise I'll propose 25% + $10k onboarding + conversion-credit.
kevin: I'll prep client comms for the 25% proposal and conversion refunding.
anna: closing loop — will update here with final SOW by 5pm PST today. Thanks everyone.
